tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Base app background (pure white) and card fill.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Stucco off-white: grouped areas, map backdrop, input fill, audio bar. Never as card-on-card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Near-black ink with a faint green warmth: all primary text, icons and text on yellow, green-400 and sky-400 fills.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, helper text, metadata. The only grey allowed for running text.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Non-text only (3:1): inactive icons, disabled text, input borders. Never for readable text.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and resting card borders (decorative, 1px).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control (inputs, secondary buttons, toggles): 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: yellow-50
tokens.usage: Brand tint: Santi speech bubble, warning background, pressed card in high contrast.

tokens.name: yellow-100
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed tint on yellow-50 surfaces, progress track.

tokens.name: yellow-200
tokens.usage: Decorative: illustration accents, optional-point dashed ring fill. No text on it except ink.

tokens.name: yellow-400
tokens.usage: LEAD COLOR (La Merced facade yellow): primary buttons, active tab, progress fill, optional points. Text on it: ink only.

tokens.name: yellow-500
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed fill.

tokens.name: yellow-600
tokens.usage: Primary button 3D edge (3:1 on white). Not for text.

tokens.name: yellow-800
tokens.usage: Yellow-family TEXT on light surfaces: eyebrow labels (5.8:1 on white).

tokens.name: yellow-900
tokens.usage: Strong yellow-family text when yellow-800 is too light (on yellow-100/200).

tokens.name: green-50
tokens.usage: Success tint background.

tokens.name: green-100
tokens.usage: Completed-point halo, success hover.

tokens.name: green-400
tokens.usage: SANTI GREEN (sampled from the mascot): Santi, celebration accents. Text on it: ink only. Never text color.

tokens.name: green-600
tokens.usage: Decorative strokes and illustration shading next to Santi.

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Completed point fill (white check), success text, toggles on. 5.4:1 on white.

tokens.name: green-900
tokens.usage: Darkest green: text on green-100, header band alternative.

tokens.name: orange-50
tokens.usage: Warning tint background.

tokens.name: orange-100
tokens.usage: Warning hover tint.

tokens.name: orange-400
tokens.usage: Decorative orange: warning illustration accents. Not text, not an icon on white.

tokens.name: orange-700
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons (5.7:1 on white).

tokens.name: orange-800
tokens.usage: Strong warning text on orange-100.

tokens.name: red-50
tokens.usage: Error tint background.

tokens.name: red-100
tokens.usage: Error hover tint.

tokens.name: red-400
tokens.usage: SANTI RED (chest): mascot and celebration confetti only. Fails as text and as a marker with white numbers.

tokens.name: red-600
tokens.usage: Essential point markers (white number), error text and icons, destructive actions. 5.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: red-800
tokens.usage: Error text on red-50/red-100.

tokens.name: sky-50
tokens.usage: Info tint: info banners, audio/transcript panel background.

tokens.name: sky-100
tokens.usage: Info hover, 3D-button pressed tint.

tokens.name: sky-400
tokens.usage: SECONDARY ACCENT (the sky over the facade): accent button "Ver como era", audio play disc, info illustrations. Text on it: ink only.

tokens.name: sky-600
tokens.usage: Decorative sky strokes; accent button 3D edge.

tokens.name: sky-700
tokens.usage: Links, info text, focus ring. White text on it passes (5.4:1).

tokens.name: sky-900
tokens.usage: Strong info text on sky-100.

tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a list; chip padding-x.

tokens.usage: Screen gutter (left/right), card padding, default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a title block and its content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sheet padding; gap between sections of a ficha.

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top padding of hero headers.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Separation between screen regions (hero vs list).

tokens.name: space-16
